REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 8, 2015 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
JANUARY 08, 2015 IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Frank Liu, First Evangelical Church of Cerritos.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Boy Scout Troop 394.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Joseph Cho, Ph.D.
  Council/Agency Member George Ray
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Carol Chen
  Mayor/Chair Mark E. Pulido

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Proclamations were presented as follows:

  Yasin Kabir, Nikhil Mohan, Nigam Patel, Bala Kumar Sridhar, Shrineel Patel, Nitin
  Sampath, Sham Shah, Nijanith Velmanikandan, Arjun Nathan (achieving the rank of
  Eagle Scout).

  A Certificate was presented to Kevin Suresh, Buena Park resident (achieving the rank
  of Eagle Scout).

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  James Han, spoke regarding the acorn trees at his property.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
  motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency
  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated
  January 8, 2015 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Cho, to approve the Register of
  Demands dated January 8, 2015 in the total amount of $8,706,640.16 (COUNCIL). The
  motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Cho, Ray, Chen, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Cho, to approve the Register of

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 76-28(A)(2014) AMENDMENT, A

  EXTRA SPACE PROPERTIES EIGHTY ONE, LLC, TO REMODEL THE FAÇADE OF AN
  EXISTING SELF STORAGE BUILDING AND ADD ENHANCED LANDSCAPING ALONG THE
  NORTHERN SIDE OF THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 10815 ARTESIA BOULEVARD,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED INDUSTRIAL
  (M) (APN 7034-001-005) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this
  project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Sandy Cisneros, Senior Planner. A PowerPoint Presentation
  was displayed.
 City of Cerritos  January 8, 2015

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)
  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Ariel Valli, Architect representing Valli Architectural Group, spoke regarding the

  The Mayor closed public comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Cho, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2015-01, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS

  VALLI ARCHITECTURAL GROUP ON BEHALF OF PROPERTY OWNER EXTRA

  ZONED INDUSTRIAL (M) (APN 7034-001-005) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Cho, Ray, Chen, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of a professional services agreement for design services for
  the expansion of the Cerritos Recycled Water System to serve Forest Lawn Memorial
  Park in the City of Cypress (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public comments. Noting there were no members of the public
  who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Ray, to:

  1. Approve a contract with VA Consulting in the amount of $151,309 for design services
  for the expansion of the Cerritos recycled water system to serve Forest Lawn Memorial
  park in the City of Cypress, and;
  1. Authorize the City Manager to execute the associated contract documents, and;
  2. Authorize the City Manager to execute a written Notice-To-Proceed to VA
  Consulting with an amendment to include an unconditional release from Golden
  State Water Company, and;
  3. Authorize staff to negotiate with VA Consulting for additional services as
  necessary to complete the project.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:
 City of Cerritos  January 8, 2015

9A.  (continued)

  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of Calmet Services’ 2015 solid waste collection program
  rate limits (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Environmental Services Manager. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments. Noting there were no members of the public
  who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Cho, to:

  1. Approve CalMet Services’ request to adjust the maximum rate schedule for solid
  waste services in the City of Cerritos by the following amounts effective January 1,
  2015:
  Residential:  2.3% increase
  Commercial Bin:  1.7% increase
  Roll-Off:  0.6% increase

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Cho, Ray, Chen, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a request from the Cerritos Regional Chamber of
  Commerce to conduct a candidate forum relating to the March 3, 2015 General
  Municipal Election (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened the public comments. Noting there were no members of the public
  who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Barrows, to approve the request by
  the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce to conduct a candidate forum in the City
  Council Chamber on Tuesday, February 3, 2015, and underwrite the cost of the cablecast.
  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Cho, Ray, Chen, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of a tie-in agreement between the City of Cerritos
  and Suburban Water Systems for a two-way water interconnection in the vicinity of
  Valley View Avenue and Park Place in the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  January 8, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9D.  (continued)

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments. Noting there were no members of the public
  who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Cho, for the City Council to:

  1. Authorize the installation of a permanent water interconnection in the vicinity of
  Valley View Avenue and Park Place in order to provide additional water to
  Suburban Water System in the event that they lose adequate water supply to
  their service area bordered by the 5 Freeway, Valley View Avenue, and Artesia
  Boulevard, and;
  2. Authorize the interconnection installation by Suburban Water system at their cost
  and be inspected by the City of Cerritos, and;
  3. Authorize the purchase of a two-way water meter with a cost not to exceed
  $7,500.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Cho, Ray, Chen, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  None.

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Cho, Ray, Barrows, Mayor Pro Tem Chen,
